detail.longDescription: Hi, my name is Ícaro Teles; I’m a 14-year-old Brazilian teenager (as of 2026). I started out in the tech world six years ago, and I’ve noticed that nowadays, 90% of programmers don't read articles or seek to learn anymore—they just practice what's known as "vibecoding." In my opinion, AI should be used, but for learning purposes—not just for copy-pasting. What do you think about that? # ai # discuss # learning # programming # software # coding # development # engineering # inclusive # community The use of AI in 2026 what do you think?
